sample_definition.structure_plate: One existing simulation-prepared starting structure per state (3HG1-derived MEL5;4JFF-derived alpha24beta17). One HLA1–180 CA alignment and one shared camera/crop.
sample_definition.distance: Two prespecified named atom pairs measured once in each structure. No mean, spread, confidence interval or hypothesis test applies.
sample_definition.predictions: One deterministic joint-model output per state; all45 aligned CDR positions plotted. Q72 Hchi and betaG54 RMSF values attached to corresponding residues.
sample_definition.interface_selection: All23 valid same-amino-acid pMHC interface sites retained in source and examined to locate largest Hchi decrease; no rank panel or input-removal contrast plotted.
sample_definition.prose_MD: Three existing independent ITrace trajectories per state; equal-weight means for local contact and same-frame two-hydrogen-bond occupancy; no MD profile shown.

model.outputs: RMSF in Angstrom; fixed-chi joint-state entropy Hchi in nats

scope: Paired local geometry and model dynamic response. Distances are not direct affinity predictions and no direction of Hchi-to-RMSF causation is inferred.
